parameters.name: Algorithm
parameters.description:
The type of the encryption algorithm. Valid values:

*   **NotSM2**: The encryption algorithm is not the SM2 algorithm. This is the default value.
*   **SM2**: The encryption algorithm is the SM2 algorithm.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: Outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-certs --domain example.aliyun.com --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-5yd0000tb02 --algorithm SM2 --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfmoiy0000p2oq --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
